_comment: This file maps Microsoft Graph API user attributes to Jira Cloud Assets object type attributes.
Keys are Microsoft Graph API attribute names
Values are the exact attribute names in your Jira Cloud Assets object type
=== The following attributes don't have equivalents in Microsoft Graph API ===
Software Asset Administrator (not available in Microsoft Graph)
Cost centre (not available in Microsoft Graph)
1. Copy this file and rename it (e.g., custom_mapping.json)
2. Update the values on the right to match your exact Jira Cloud Assets attribute names
3. Run the script with: npm start -- --mapping custom_mapping.json
4. The script will query your object type and use attribute names to find correct IDs
Note: Attribute names on the right side must EXACTLY match your Jira Cloud Assets object type attribute names
